description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerService class, which provides methods to interact with PerformanceTracker entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving the data access object (DAO) and updating performance trackers, with logic to check edit permissions.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerService
classes.description: Service class for managing performance tracking, including retrieval and update of performance tracker data, with permission checks.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerDao
methods.description: Returns the PerformanceTrackerDao object, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: updateTracker
methods.description: Updates a PerformanceTracker entity for specified reviewers, throwing an exception if the tracker is not editable by the owner.
